finding: An early-GDN candidate duplicates the incumbent 128-thread Q/K norm tree across four disjoint 32-column blocks per v-head. At rows508, recurrent state is bit-exact and device wall improves 12.628->12.227 ms (1.0328x), but output is not exact; a debug rerun finds about 25% mismatches in each 32-column quarter. The reduced head_dim8 one-block fixture masked the cross-block output failure. Candidate is removed before model timing.

host.hardware: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S gfx1151

scope.shape: rows508 k_heads16 v_heads16 head_dim128 FP32 state
scope.mechanism: four 32-column blocks per v-head plus exact norm/gate tail

correctness.note: One-block reduced fixture did not cover cross-block output behavior.

decision.next: Do not qualify early-GDN parallel columns from a one-block fixture. Add production-width output oracle before any new layout candidate; continue QSA flash or GDN state-layout work.
